determinism_findings.verdict: No determinism risks found in the bounded proposal when the required conditions below are met.
reasoning: The inputs are fixed JSON files selected by an explicit root; no randomness, timestamps, unstable enumeration, or serialized derived field is added.
Both sets are replaced before simulation consumers on every desktop advance, so alternating roots cannot inherit stale membership.
Set membership lookup does not depend on iteration order, and the proposal does not serialize either Set.
Default-cwd scenario callers retain their current behavior, while desktop execution becomes independent of ambient cwd and prior entry points.
citations: docs/20_engineering/DETERMINISM_TEST_MATRIX.md sections No timestamps / wall-clock values, Stable ordering, Derived state not serialized, Byte-identical reruns, and Full vitest suite required on code-path PRs

required_implementation_conditions: Keep the change limited to src/sim/combat/combat_terrain_sets_node.ts, src/desktop/desktop_sim.ts, and focused tests unless a separately justified correction is required.
The optional loader baseDir must resolve data/derived/operational/urban_osids.json and forest_osids.json beneath that root; omission must continue to use process.cwd().

Preserve the current missing, unreadable, and malformed-file policy: return an empty Set rather than throw. Test this policy explicitly. Desktop advance must still set both globals from those results so a missing file clears stale data from a prior root.
Prime both sets before constructing or running BotManager and before runTurn. Do not add GameState/save fields or derive terrain from player metadata.
Do not change terrain files, memberships, multipliers, thresholds, operation catalogs, control data, movement, alliances, supply, enclave rules, prediction/preview design, or cache ordering.
Do not modify scenario startup semantics beyond the compatible optional-loader signature.

package_and_native: Build a new immutable package. Inventory must prove both terrain JSON files exist at process.resourcesPath/data/derived/operational and that compiled desktop_sim uses the explicit packaged baseDir before simulation consumers.
Run the cheap packaged production opening/one-advance probe before any full native run. A successful advance alone is insufficient if the inventory or compiled-consumer assertions are absent.
